5: import { auth } from "./lib/auth";
6: import { initializeKafkaRPC } from "./modules/kafka";
7: 
8: const PORT = config.port;
9: 
10: const isProduction = process.env.NODE_ENV === "production";
11: 
12: const opt: FastifyServerOptions = {
13:   logger: {
14:     transport: isProduction
15:       ? undefined
16:       : {
17:           target: "pino-pretty",
18:         },
19:   },
20:   routerOptions: {
21:     ignoreTrailingSlash: true,
22:   },
23: };
24: 
25: // Initialize Kafka RPC before building the server
26: await initializeKafkaRPC();
27: 
28: const app = await buildServer(opt);
29: 
30: // 1. Authentication route - Proxy to authentication service
31: app.route({
32:   method: ["GET", "POST"],
33:   url: "/api/auth/*",
34:   async handler(request, reply) {
35:     try{
36:       const url = new URL(request.url, `http://${request.headers.host}`);
37: 
38:       const headers = fromNodeHeaders(request.headers);
39: 
40:       const req = new Request(url.toString(), {
41:         method: request.method,
42:         headers,
43:         ...(request.body ? { body: JSON.stringify(request.body) } : {}),
44:       });
45:       // Process authentication request
46:       const response = await auth.handler(req);
47:       // Forward response to client
48:       reply.status(response.status);
49:       response.headers.forEach((value, key) => reply.header(key, value));
50:       return reply.send(response.body ? await response.text() : null);
51:     } catch (error: unknown) {
52:       app.log.error("Authentication Error:");
53:       return reply.status(500).send({ 
54:         error: "Internal authentication error",
55:         code: "AUTH_FAILURE"
56:       });
57:     }
58:   }
59: })
60: 
61: const server = app.listen({ port: PORT, host: "0.0.0.0" }, (err, address) => {
62:   if (err) {
63:     app.log.error(err);
64:     process.exit(1);
65:   }
66:   app.log.info(`Server listening at ${address}`);
67: });
68: 
69: export { app, server };

meta {

}
